import subprocess,json,os,re,sys,shutil
root='/tmp/jacobian-lens'
shutil.rmtree(root,ignore_errors=True)
p=subprocess.run(['git','clone','--depth','1','https://github.com/anthropics/jacobian-lens.git',root],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=50)
out={'clone_returncode':p.returncode,'clone_stderr_tail':p.stderr[-800:]}
if p.returncode==0:
 c=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','compileall','-q',os.path.join(root,'jlens')],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=40)
 out['compile_returncode']=c.returncode;out['compile_stderr_tail']=c.stderr[-800:]
 readme=open(os.path.join(root,'README.md'),encoding='utf-8').read()
 pyproj=open(os.path.join(root,'pyproject.toml'),encoding='utf-8').read()
 out['readme_mentions_qwen']='qwen' in readme.lower()
 out['readme_mentions_huggingface']='huggingface' in readme.lower()
 out['jlens_py_files']=sum(1 for dp,_,fs in os.walk(os.path.join(root,'jlens')) for f in fs if f.endswith('.py'))
 out['tests_py_files']=sum(1 for dp,_,fs in os.walk(os.path.join(root,'tests')) for f in fs if f.endswith('.py'))
 out['pyproject_head']=pyproj[:1600]
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
